records.text: A redacted UVU email sender wrote that they thought the Fulton Library Quad would be a better space if the group drew a large crowd; Owens placed the message on August 21.
records.speaker: Anonymous UVU email sender (Ep 389; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: They wrote, quote, also, we think that the Fulton Library Quad would be better space-wise for the group if they get a large crowd in the area, the sender wrote. ... On August 21st, apparently referring to the Fulton Library quad across campus, the recipient of the message's name was also redacted by UVU.

conveyance.original_source: UVU email quoted in ABC News
